beats.say: Microsoft To Do, the free task and daily planning app used for the better part of nine years, will go away forever on June 30, 2027.
Microsoft paid 100 to 200 million dollars in 2015 for Wunderlist, the app that became To Do's core, after shutting Wunderlist down in 2020.
The piece rounds up five replacement task apps for anyone who needs a new daily planning tool.
